response.sql: WITH status_avg AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS pulse_avg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS mean_avg FROM status_avg), first_kept AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.pulse_avg FROM status_avg AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE a.pulse_avg > m.mean_avg), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS mean_avg FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(k.pulse_avg) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.pulse_avg - m1.mean_avg) AS avg_excess_first_mean, AVG(k.pulse_avg - m2.mean_avg) AS avg_excess_second_mean FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m1 CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m2 WHERE k.pulse_avg > m2.mean_avg

assumptions.assumption: Each detected signal with a non-null pulse rate has equal weight in its equipment status average.

alternatives.interpretation: Average each telescope's detected pulse rates first, then give each telescope equal weight within its equipment status.
